Want to capture the attention of tens of thousands of anime and comic fans at once? Get prioritized opportunities to be recommended to domestic and international publishing houses and become an officially serialized online author. Welcome to participate in the Comic Frontier Micro Short Story Original Contest (開拓極短篇原創大賞) [CHECK], letting your work take you into a wider world.

The 2026 15th Comic Frontier Micro Short Story Original Contest (第十五屆開拓極短篇原創大賞) [CHECK] is calling for submissions! In addition to bonuses or gifts for selected winners, "CLIP STUDIO PAINT" is specially sponsoring drawing device activation codes for creators this year, bringing higher quality support to creative work.

Selection announcements will be published in the "Frontier Comic Festival Event Pamphlet" read by tens of thousands of visitors. All selected works will be compiled into an electronic special edition for promotion, with opportunities to become priority invited creators for Frontier series pamphlets and promotions.

Please refer to the official event website for detailed submission specifications and registration forms.
